_comment: Copy to <PT_RESEARCH_HOME>/local.paths.json (default ~/.config/pt-research/local.paths.json; this survives plugin updates). A git-ignored local.paths.json in the plugin directory also works but is lost when a marketplace-installed plugin is updated. Lookup order per key: environment variable, <PT_RESEARCH_HOME>/local.paths.json, <plugin>/local.paths.json, <plugin>/.env.local, default. PT_RESEARCH_HOME itself is read from the environment only. Every key is optional; omit a key to use the default or skip the dependent feature.
PT_WORKSPACE_ROOT: /path/to/workspace containing deliverables/ and tmp/ (default: current directory)
RUNTIME_PYTHON: /path/to/python3 used by the slide builder's package validators
PT_LOCAL_REFERENCES_DIR: /path/to/folder holding the private CYPT reference decks (optional; default <PT_RESEARCH_HOME>/local-references, restored with scripts/fetch_local_references.py)
